description.value:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the doors to area H17 or attempts to disable the hazard and fails

Effect The light from the statue's eyes intensifies. The statue casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Overwhelming Presence] (@Check[will|dc:41|options:area-effect,item:type:spell|traits:auditory,concentrate,incapacitation,manipulate,mental,visual]), targeting each living creature in the room. The hazard then rolls initiative.

details.description: A statue dedicated to Ydersius fills the chamber with the divine glory of the Father of Serpents.
details.disable: @Check[deception|dc:43] (master) to falsely proclaim the party's devotion to Ydersius, @Check[religion|dc:41] (master) to rededicate the statue to Yig, or @Check[thievery|dc:38] (expert) twice to pry the statue's eyes from their sockets
details.reset: Unless the statue is destroyed, both its eyes are removed, or the statue is rededicated to Yig, the hazard deactivates and resets 1 minute after no living creatures are in the room.
details.routine: (2 actions) The statue uses each of its two actions to cast a 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Blazing Bolt] spell (DC 41), targeting up to three living creatures per casting. For each eye removed from the statue, the hazard has 1 fewer action. Until the beginning of the statue's next turn, the doors to area H17 don't require an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Force Open] (but opening them still requires an Interact action).
